actions.label: Evaluate synthetic Sales Credit order or interaction
actions.accepted_input: One reserved synthetic OrderId and an optional 1..128 character request key accepted by validate_request_key; source facts come from the retained scenario instance, not the form.
actions.actor_requirement: SYSTEM; no human authority is asserted by evaluation.
actions.confirmation_requirement: Explicit click is required; a second confirmation dialog is not required because evaluation is local, synthetic, and creates no human outcome or external action.
actions.request_key: Bound by ScenarioApplication.evaluate to order_id plus the retained source binding. The dashboard supplies a bounded key.
actions.receipt_event_result: EvaluationResultView plus the durable evaluation binding, telemetry terminal row, durable attempt, and the underlying Sales Credit DurableCommandResult/event graph.
actions.replay_behavior: The same request key and identical bound order/source returns the retained evaluation with replayed=true and does not allocate a new evaluation.
actions.conflict_behavior: The same request key with changed order/source material raises IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MATERIAL_CONFLICT before a new evaluation is persisted.
actions.projection_effects: Updates the current Sales Credit case projection exactly once from the committed evaluator result.
actions.history_effects: Appends the first successful evaluation attempt; replay is recorded as request history/telemetry and is not a new evaluation.
m7_tests_required: replay does not increment unique evaluations

actions.label: Record manager outcome
actions.accepted_input: OrderId plus ManagerOutcome. The UI admits only APPROVED, DENIED, PARTIAL, OTHER_REP, or NOT_PURSUED; PARTIAL requires positive exact Money with a registered currency. active_note is not exposed.
actions.actor_requirement: A bounded reserved synthetic RepId; the repository independently requires an eligible current workflow/evaluation and no pending replacement child authority conflict.
actions.confirmation_requirement: Required. The dialog repeats the synthetic order, closed outcome, actor, and exact amount/currency when PARTIAL.
actions.request_key: Required 1..96 character Control Center key passed unchanged to record_manager_outcome and bound to ManagerOutcome canonical bytes by SQLiteIdempotencyRepository.
actions.receipt_event_result: DurableCommandResult; immutable ManagerOutcome; OUTCOME_RECORDED sc_case_event; updated StoredSalesCreditCase projection.
actions.replay_behavior: Same key and byte-identical ManagerOutcome returns the retained DurableCommandResult with replayed=true and appends nothing.
actions.conflict_behavior: Same key with changed canonical ManagerOutcome raises IdempotencyConflictError(IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MATERIAL_CONFLICT) before allocation.
actions.projection_effects: Sets only manager_occurrence_id and the authorized workflow closure projection. The retained system attribution/classification and evaluation are unchanged.
actions.history_effects: Appends one immutable manager outcome and one OUTCOME_RECORDED event. Replay is a receipt, not a second outcome/event.
m7_tests_required: all five enum values are closed
success, exact replay, and changed-material conflict

actions.label: Evaluate synthetic DOI order
actions.accepted_input: One reserved synthetic OrderId and an optional 1..128 character request key; the retained complete source fixture is the only evaluation material.
actions.actor_requirement: SYSTEM; evaluation never asserts human authority.
actions.confirmation_requirement: Explicit click is required; no second confirmation dialog is required.
actions.request_key: Bound to the order and retained source binding by ScenarioApplication.evaluate and to the DOI demo command material by durable idempotency.
actions.receipt_event_result: EvaluationResultView plus durable DOI run/snapshot/evaluation graph, DurableCommandResult, telemetry, and attempt history.
actions.replay_behavior: Same key/material returns the retained evaluation with replayed=true; it creates no human fact, intervention, resulting-order link, or value.
actions.conflict_behavior: Changed material under the same key fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MATERIAL_CONFLICT before a successful evaluation is added.
actions.projection_effects: Updates the current DOI case/evaluation projection exactly once using evaluate_doi output.
actions.history_effects: Retains the first immutable evaluation graph. Replay/conflict remain request history and do not become unique evaluations.
m7_tests_required: evaluation cannot create a human fact
evaluation cannot create intervention, resulting link, or value

actions.label: Select one exact overlap scenario
actions.accepted_input: Current synthetic DOI case/evaluation identity, one selected opportunity ID, the exact sorted option-opportunity ID set already present in the unresolved overlap evaluation, reserved synthetic actor, required confirmation flag, and a 1..96 character Control Center request key. IDs, source, context, timestamps, and authority material are loaded or generated server-side from the retained synthetic graph.
actions.actor_requirement: A reserved synthetic RepId crossing verify_synthetic_human_authority against the exact open retained DOIActionContext and synthetic interaction SourceRef.
actions.confirmation_requirement: Required. The dialog names the case, selected opportunity, all mutually exclusive options, actor, and the effect: recompute aggregate potential without merging or deleting opportunities.
actions.request_key: Required and bound by SQLiteIdempotencyRepository to canonical command bytes containing the exact case/evaluation, option set, selected opportunity, actor, and confirmation material.
actions.receipt_event_result: DurableCommandResult whose result binds the recomputed DOIEvaluation; immutable DOIHumanFactEvent/StructuredHumanFact with usage SCENARIO_SELECTION and result SCENARIO_SELECTED; owner event and durable evaluation append in one transaction.
actions.replay_behavior: Same key and identical canonical selection returns the original durable receipt and performs no reducer, owner-event, or evaluation append.
actions.conflict_behavior: Same key with any changed selected opportunity, option set, case/evaluation, actor, or confirmation material raises IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MATERIAL_CONFLICT before any append.
actions.projection_effects: Re-evaluates the same retained facts with one validated ScenarioSelection. Opportunities remain separate; only scenario_selection_state and the already-defined aggregate-potential result change according to evaluate_doi.
actions.history_effects: Appends one immutable structured human fact/owner event and one new immutable evaluation. Prior unresolved evaluation remains history. No new reason, transition, intervention, resulting link, or value rule is introduced.
m7_tests_required: unrelated opportunities and source facts unchanged

actions.label: Create a verified backup
actions.accepted_input: A required confirmation and bounded request key; the server, not the browser, derives one safe non-reparse destination beneath the managed local backups directory. Arbitrary paths and overwrite are not accepted.
actions.actor_requirement: Local operator action; no Sales Credit or DOI human authority is asserted.
actions.confirmation_requirement: Required. It states that a new local verified snapshot and receipt will be created and that no restore occurs.
actions.request_key: Required by the M7 adapter and used only to derive/deduplicate the bounded managed destination; it is never accepted as a path. Exact existing receipt verification is replay; changed material under the same key is conflict.
actions.receipt_event_result: BackupReceipt from create_backup, immediately equal to verify_backup readback; the existing backup_receipts row and signed sidecar remain the authoritative history.
actions.replay_behavior: Same key/material returns the already verified managed receipt and creates no second backup.
actions.conflict_behavior: The browser exposes no second material field to change. Unsafe or arbitrary destinations are absent from the request schema and the derived path still fails closed under create_backup path policy.
actions.history_effects: One immutable verified backup receipt for the first accepted key; replay does not add another receipt.
m7_tests_required: exact replay with no client-controlled alternate material

actions.replay_behavior: Repeated reads return current verified receipt state without mutation.
actions.conflict_behavior: Read-only receipt projection has no conflict. Failed or incomplete receipts remain explicit status rows; no raw error or filesystem path is returned.
